text:
Hannah: Quick heads-up from a customer call — on narrow phones the filter drawer we collapse into a bottom sheet is clipping the table CTA (Save/Run). Users can't reach the button when the keyboard is up. Short clip: https://imgur.com/clip-filter-sheet.mp4
Vikram: repro'd on iPhone SE & Pixel 3a. Steps: Console -> Policies -> tap filter -> sheet opens -> tap an input -> keyboard appears -> bottom CTA hidden under keyboard. Seems like sheet is 100vh and doesn't account for soft keyboard.
Jose: I saw a similar bug earlier with our chat UI. Workarounds: 1) move primary CTA into sheet header when an input is focused, 2) detect keyboard and switch sheet to compact mode (move buttons above keyboard), 3) use viewport height workaround `height: calc(var(--vh, 1vh) * 100)` and update --vh on resize.
Mei: accessibility note: if we move the CTA into the header we must update aria-labels, announce the change with `aria-live` and ensure focus is preserved on the input. Also avoid hiding siblings without aria-hidden toggles.
Hannah: product ask: prefer minimal visual change for now. Can we make CTA float above keyboard when input focused and keep the sheet close-to-native? That keeps discoverability and is less jarring. Marking RD-3810 P2.
Vikram: quick CSS prototype: `.sheet { position: fixed; bottom: 0; } .sheet.keyboard-active .sheet-cta { position: absolute; bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 12px); transform: translateY(-8px); }` For detection: `window.addEventListener('resize', () => { if (window.innerHeight < initialHeight - 150) document.body.classList.add('keyboard-active') })`. Falls back to media query for small heights.
Jose: small dev caveat: on some iOS WKWebView the resize event is flaky. The `--vh` hack plus `visualViewport` API (`visualViewport.height`) is more reliable if available. Use feature-detect then fallback to innerHeight.
Mei: copy tweak: when sheet is in keyboard mode change action text from "Run" -> "Apply", and add aria-label="Apply filters". Also change the ephemeral helper text from "Filter results" -> "Filtering results" while typing for SR clarity.
Hannah: QA: runs fail 6/10 on Safari mobile in CI. Repro steps and logs in ticket RD-3810: https://tests.redwood/3810. Please include device lab captures in the PR.
Vikram: I'll spin up a small patch behind a flag: 1) visualViewport + innerHeight delta detection, 2) `.keyboard-active` class toggle, 3) floating CTA with safe-area padding and sheet header fallback, 4) simple animation for translateY to avoid overlap flicker.
Jose: also add `aria-hidden="true"` to non-essential controls when keyboard-active so screen readers don't focus hidden targets. And ensure the floating CTA is reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space).
Mei: design ask: add a visible grab handle and 8px extra top padding to the sheet when in keyboard mode so the header doesn't collide with the sticky table header. Update Figma: https://figma.com/file/MOBILE/filter-sheet-keyboard-mode :memo:
ui-bot: new figma uploaded for keyboard-aware sheet with specs for 320px, 360px, and 412px breakpoints. Includes touch target guidance and copy changes.
Hannah: please include visual regression screenshots for small heights and a short device lab video. Assigning to @Vikram + @Jose. Scheduling hotfix for next patch. :thumbsup:
qa-bot: added mobile/keyboard-sheet test to CI. Current flakiness 5/10 on iOS 14. Ticket RD-3810 updated.
Vikram: starting PR draft. Will include a small JS helper with feature-detect, CSS changes, and accessibility annotations. Will ping for design review when demo is up.
Hannah: thank you 44d. Closing thread — I'll update RD-3810 with the acceptance criteria and test matrix.
